retrievalProfile.description: A stark, high-contrast graphic featuring a back-view silhouette of a seated figure against a split background with bold, heavy sans-serif typography.
triggerTerms: stark red and black minimalist poster
excludeWhen: soft pastel color palettes are requested
ornate or serif typography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tier vertical composition: a top section with a black silhouette of a man in a suit seated on a sofa against a light grey gradient; a middle section dominated by massive, ultra-bold sans-serif text; and a bottom section featuring a black field with a pixelated, abstract representation of a night-time city skyline.
coreVisualRelationships: The silhouette's arm rests on the top edge of the central typography block.
The color split in the typography mirrors the transition from the figure to the dark base.
The pixelated city lights provide a textural contrast to the flat vector shapes above.
coreInvariants: High-contrast black, white, and red color palette.
Back-view silhouette with sharp, clean vector edges.
Ultra-bold, condensed sans-serif typography as a structural anchor.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The silhouette is centered horizontally in the upper half, appearing life-sized relative to the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive central typography acts as the primary visual weight and horizon line.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the head of the silhouette, moves down the arm to the right, drops into the bold text, and settles on the pixelated base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper light grey gradient provides significant breathing room for the dark silhouette.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with zero mid-tones in the subject; high saturation in the red accent.

letterConstructionRules: Large x-height with no descenders visible
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are cropped at the bottom by the lower graphic element

composition.relationshipToImage: acts as a floor for the silhouette
anchored to the baseline of the display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Scale contrast: massive display sans-serif paired with a much smaller, lighter version of the same typeface family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, mid-century corporate aesthetic and heavy weight.
Provides the necessary verticality and weight if a more modern font is unavailable.
Offers a similar authoritative, industrial feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a three-part vertical composition. Top: a light grey gradient background with a black silhouette of a man in a 1960s suit seated on a sofa, back to the viewer, arm resting on an invisible ledge. Middle: a solid black horizontal band. Bottom: a black field filled with small, scattered white and grey square pixels resembling a distant city at night.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-bold, condensed uppercase sans-serif text across the middle. The first half of the word should be vibrant red, the second half white. Place smaller subtitle text in white sans-serif at the bottom right of the main text block.

verificationChecks: Is the silhouette purely black with no internal detail?
Is the main text ultra-bold and condensed?
Does the red color have high saturation?
Is the bottom texture composed of distinct square pixels?

adjustableVariables: Density of the pixelated city lights
Gradient intensity of the top background

mustAchieve: Perfect horizontal alignment of text and graphic boundaries

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the silhouette's arm appears to rest exactly on the top of the text.
Verify the text is split into two distinct colors.
Check that the bottom section uses a pixelated/mosaic effect rather than a photo.
Confirm the background is a smooth, subtle gradient.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject Silhouette] + [Oversized Split-Color Sans-Serif] + [Pixelated Texture Base] using a [High-Contrast Noir Palette].
